articles.title: Zero Latency VR Launches 'Venue Success' Operator Support Program
articles.summary: Zero Latency VR has created a dedicated Venue Success program and hired industry veteran Brett Bovio to lead it, providing FEC operators in its global network with hands-on practical support beyond technology installation. The move signals a shift toward lifecycle operator partnerships rather than simple equipment sales. For FEC venues running free-roam VR, this kind of ongoing operational guidance can directly impact throughput, uptime, and guest satisfaction scores.

articles.title: Hololabs Studio Debuts Next-Gen LBE VR Format at IAAPA Expo Europe
articles.summary: Canadian studio Hololabs is introducing a ticketed, guided, multi-room experience at IAAPA Expo Europe that combines physical themed sets with mixed reality, aiming to solve the classic LBE trilemma of immersion, capacity, and footprint. The team brings credits including Mario Kart ride systems at Universal Studios, lending serious credibility to the concept. FEC operators seeking differentiated VR attractions that scale commercially should take note of this format.

articles.title: Indoor Entertainment Drives UAE Attractions Boom
articles.summary: A new report highlights how indoor entertainment concepts are fueling a surge in attractions investment across the UAE, pointing to climate-driven demand for climate-controlled experiences. The trend mirrors patterns seen in other hot-weather markets and underscores indoor FEC as a resilient format globally. Operators and investors eyeing international expansion will find the UAE market dynamics instructive.

articles.title: Slick City and Activeon Expand Action Park Brand Into Sweden and Austria
articles.summary: Slick City, the indoor slide-based action park concept, is accelerating European expansion through a partnership with Activeon, with new parks opening in Sweden and Austria. The move shows how modular indoor adventure park formats are crossing borders rapidly. FEC operators and investors should watch how the Slick City model performs in European markets with different labor costs and consumer habits.

articles.title: Texas's Largest Family Entertainment Center Targets 2026 Houston Opening
articles.summary: A new FEC billing itself as the largest in Texas is set to open in the Houston area in 2026, signaling continued investor confidence in large-format family entertainment despite broader economic headwinds. The project underscores the ongoing race to build destination-level FECs in major metro markets. Competitors and suppliers operating in the Southwest region should monitor this development closely.

articles.title: Jora Vision Expands Into Competitive Socializing With New Portfolio
articles.summary: Experience design firm Jora Vision is growing its competitive socializing offering, combining game mechanics with themed environments to create skill-based social attractions. The competitive socializing segment continues to attract investment as operators seek experiences that drive longer dwell times and repeat visits. FEC operators looking to add revenue layers beyond traditional arcade play will find Jora Vision's approach worth examining.

articles.title: Six Flags and Warner Bros. Invest in Premium Interactive Horror With 'The Conjuring: Beyond Fear'
articles.summary: Six Flags is partnering with Plague Productions and Warner Bros. Discovery Global Experiences to deliver a premium-priced, interactive haunted attraction based on The Conjuring IP for its Halloween season. The investment reflects a broader industry push toward upcharge, immersive Halloween experiences that command higher per-capita spending. FEC operators running seasonal scare events can draw lessons from how major park operators are premiumizing the Halloween calendar.

articles.title: India's Amusement Industry Posts Summer Growth but Rising Costs Squeeze Margins
articles.summary: India's amusement and attractions sector saw strong attendance growth in summer 2026, but operators are being pressured by rising costs including labor, energy, and imported equipment. The margin squeeze echoes challenges faced by FEC operators in Western markets and highlights the need for operational efficiency tools. Suppliers targeting the Indian market should be aware that price sensitivity and total cost of ownership are top-of-mind for operators.

articles.title: India's IAAPI Pushes Government for GST Cuts to Boost Amusement Industry
articles.summary: The Indian Association of Amusement Parks and Industries is lobbying for GST rationalization, arguing that high tax rates are suppressing consumer demand and limiting industry growth. The advocacy effort mirrors similar tax-relief campaigns by FEC trade groups in other markets. International operators and suppliers with India exposure should follow the legislative outcome closely as it could reshape market economics.

articles.title: 2026 Golden Ticket Awards Recognize 28 Amusement Industry Winners
articles.summary: Amusement Today's Golden Ticket Awards honored 28 winners across theme parks, FECs, water parks, and attractions at a ceremony held at the new COTALand park in Austin. The awards are among the most-watched benchmarks of guest experience excellence in the industry. FEC operators can use the winners list as a competitive intelligence tool to identify best-practice venues in each category.

articles.title: Six Flags Earns 25 Golden Ticket Honors Across Parks and Attractions
articles.summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation took home 25 top honors at the 2026 Golden Ticket Awards, the most of any operator, spanning roller coasters, family entertainment, and immersive guest experiences. The sweep reinforces Six Flags' strategy of investing across a broad range of experience types rather than focusing solely on thrill coasters. For regional FEC operators, the Six Flags results highlight how diversified programming drives award-level guest satisfaction.

articles.title: InPark Magazine Issue 111: Frictionless Guest Experience as a Design Imperative
articles.summary: The latest issue of InPark Magazine focuses on the industry-wide push toward frictionless guest experiences, covering ticketing technology, in-park purchasing, and how design can remove barriers between guests and attractions. Contributors include accesso on ticketing friction and Jora Vision on technology-enhanced competitive socializing. FEC operators will find practical takeaways on reducing operational friction across the customer journey.

articles.title: InPark Publisher: Let the Experience Lead, Not the Technology
articles.summary: InPark Magazine publisher Martin Palicki's editorial argues that technology should serve the guest experience rather than drive it, cautioning operators against letting tools like ticketing systems or AI overshadow the core attraction. The piece frames frictionless design as a philosophy of removing obstacles, not adding gadgets. It is a timely reminder for FEC operators investing heavily in tech to keep the guest outcome as the north star.

articles.title: Round1-Style Japanese Arcade and Entertainment Center Selects Haywood Mall for First South Carolina Location
articles.summary: A Japanese arcade and entertainment center concept has chosen Haywood Mall in South Carolina for its first location in the state, continuing the trend of Asian-origin FEC brands expanding aggressively into U.S. shopping mall spaces. Mall-based FEC expansion remains one of the strongest growth vectors in the domestic market, with Japanese operators bringing dense, high-SKU game offerings that drive repeat visits. Local and regional FEC operators in the Southeast should assess the competitive impact.

articles.title: New Indoor FEC Opens in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee Over Labor Day Weekend
articles.summary: A new indoor family entertainment center debuted in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee over Labor Day weekend, adding to a wave of FEC openings across secondary markets in the South. The opening reflects continued operator confidence in suburban Tennessee markets, which have seen strong population and retail growth. Suppliers and competitors in the Nashville metro should note the new competitive entrant.

articles.title: Inside Pensacola's Massive New Launch Family Entertainment Complex
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment's new Pensacola location is one of the largest FEC openings in the Florida Panhandle in recent memory, featuring a wide array of active entertainment options. The Launch brand continues its multi-state growth strategy, targeting mid-sized markets with large-format venues. FEC investors and operators tracking the Launch expansion model will want to follow this opening's early performance metrics.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Set to Open at Golden Triangle Mall in Late October
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment is bringing another location to a shopping mall anchor space, this time at Golden Triangle Mall, with an opening planned for late October. The timing positions the venue to capture Halloween and holiday season foot traffic from day one. The mall-anchor FEC strategy continues to prove viable as traditional retailers vacate large-format spaces.

articles.title: AStation's Mixed Reality 'Cosmos' Experience Debuts at Ripley's Aquarium of the Smokies
articles.summary: AStation has launched Cosmos, its most ambitious mixed reality experience to date, inside a shark tunnel at Ripley's Aquarium of the Smokies using its proprietary Enterverse platform. The experience is the fourth mixed reality installation at the venue, demonstrating how layered MR content can refresh an existing attraction without major capital construction. FEC operators looking to add immersive revenue layers to existing floor space should examine the Enterverse model.

articles.title: Dream Garden Delivers Custom Multi-Level FEC Build for KIDDO Venue in Venezuela
articles.summary: Chinese manufacturer Dream Garden provided end-to-end concept development, custom equipment design, and technical support for the KIDDO indoor FEC at a Venezuelan shopping center, creating a branded destination rather than a generic playground. The project illustrates how international equipment suppliers are offering turnkey FEC development services, not just product supply. Operators planning new builds should be aware of the expanded scope of services now offered by manufacturers.

articles.title: The Pitch FEC Opens in Quincy With Dense Mix of Indoor Activities
articles.summary: The Pitch, a new family entertainment center packed with indoor activities, has opened in Quincy, adding another data point to the national trend of activity-dense FEC concepts launching in smaller cities. The venue's name and positioning suggest a sports-entertainment angle, a growing niche within the FEC sector. Operators building or renovating should note how activity variety is becoming a key competitive differentiator in smaller markets.

articles.title: NRG Adventure Park Coming to Jacksonville's Southside
articles.summary: NRG Adventure Park has announced plans to open a new indoor adventure park on Jacksonville's Southside, adding to the growing inventory of active entertainment options in the Florida market. The project represents continued investor appetite for adventure park formats in suburban locations. FEC operators and landlords in Florida should track NRG's expansion trajectory as a signal of competitive market saturation.

articles.title: Attraktion! Product Suite Installed at Polish Adventure Park
articles.summary: European attractions supplier Attraktion! has completed a full product catalogue installation at a new adventure park in Poland, showcasing how bundled equipment packages can accelerate venue fit-out. The installation highlights growing FEC investment in Central and Eastern Europe. Suppliers and operators watching European market expansion will find the Polish project instructive as a model for multi-attraction venue builds.

articles.title: First Renderings Revealed for Maricopa's MADCAPS Entertainment Center
articles.summary: New renderings have been released for MADCAPS, an upcoming entertainment center planned for Maricopa, Arizona, giving the first public look at the venue's design and activity mix. The project is among a growing number of purpose-built FECs targeting fast-growing Phoenix-area suburbs. Operators and developers in the Southwest should monitor MADCAPS as a case study in designing for a younger, family-dense demographic.

articles.title: Interstellar Arc Closes at Area15 After Less Than a Year
articles.summary: The Interstellar Arc attraction at Area15 in Las Vegas has closed after operating for less than 12 months, raising questions about attraction longevity and content refresh cycles in LBE entertainment complexes. The closure is a cautionary data point for FEC operators and investors evaluating capital-intensive immersive attractions with uncertain long-term demand. Understanding why experiences fail at flagship LBE destinations is as important as studying their launches.

articles.title: Apex Entertainment Renews Charity Partnership With New England Kicker Andy Borregales
articles.summary: Apex Entertainment has renewed its partnership with New England Patriots kicker Andy Borregales and the New England Center For Children, continuing a community-focused sponsorship strategy. Sports celebrity partnerships tied to local charitable causes are an effective tool for FEC operators to build brand equity and community goodwill. The Apex model offers a replicable playbook for mid-size FEC operators seeking to elevate their local marketing profile.

articles.title: Siam Park Records 20% Attendance Lift From Summer Night Event
articles.summary: Siam Park's Siam Night event, which transformed the water park into an evening festival for eight weeks, delivered a 20 percent attendance increase over the period. The result is a strong proof point for seasonal evening programming as a revenue diversification strategy for attractions that typically close at dusk. FEC operators with outdoor or after-hours potential should study the Siam Night format for adaptation.

articles.title: Out-of-Home Advertising Grows More Critical as Entertainment Decisions Go Last-Minute
articles.summary: New research shows that 14 percent of entertainment venue attendees first discovered a show or attraction through a poster or billboard, ranking OOH as the fifth-largest awareness channel ahead of TV and TikTok. With purchase windows shrinking and more guests deciding day-of, OOH keeps FEC brands visible during commuting, shopping, and dining moments when digital ads are absent. Operators investing in local marketing should reassess their OOH allocation relative to digital spend.

articles.title: Fresno Bed Bath & Beyond Space Gets New Indoor Entertainment Tenant
articles.summary: A vacant Bed Bath & Beyond big-box space in Fresno is being converted into an indoor entertainment venue, adding to a national pattern of FEC operators absorbing former retail anchor locations. The conversion trend continues to offer FEC developers access to large, affordable footprints in established retail corridors with built-in parking. Operators and developers scouting expansion sites should keep tracking big-box retail vacancies in their target markets.
